name: uberdev-codex
description: UberDev workflow toolkit for Codex: brainstorm/plan/execute, TDD, systematic-debugging, parallel-fanout PR review, autonomous GitHub issue triage and resolution. Skills ship here; the 44 subagents install separately via codex/install-codex.sh (Codex plugin manifest has no agents field).

interface.shortDescription: GitHub workflow automation, review, and issue-resolution skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: UberDev brings its brainstorm, plan, execute, TDD, debugging, PR review, and GitHub issue workflows to Codex. The plugin ships skills and runtime hooks; the standalone installer also installs the matching custom subagents.
